news: Reports Q2 FY26 earnings before the open July 29, 2026 (5 days); consensus ~$1.11-1.12B revenue, ~$0.10-0.11 adjusted EPS.
Options market is pricing an unusually large ~11.5% implied post-earnings move, above SOFI's own ~8.5% average swing over the last four quarters.
Board chair transition effective today (July 24): Carl Albert stepped down as chairman following the annual shareholder meeting; Shawn Pelsinger becomes the new board chairman.
June 30 debt restructuring swapped a $46.9M convertible note for a smaller $16.9M note plus a new $30M secured term note, easing near-term liquidity.
Wheels Up signed as launch customer for BrokerOS (up to $12M subscription revenue); Palantir SurfOS partnership expanded; still deeply unprofitable.
Morgan Stanley initiated coverage July 23 at Equal-Weight (PT $36.50), citing below-average capex returns versus data-center peers - the most direct driver of today's -9.0% move.
Sector-wide 'neocloud' selloff same day (CoreWeave -7%, Nebius -9%) on fears Meta's in-house compute buildout undercuts GPU-rental pricing; APLD swept up in the repricing.

FY2026 Q4/full-year results due after the close Monday, July 27 (3 days); consensus ~$82M revenue (+116% YoY), ~-$0.20 EPS. Nvidia's full exit from its APLD stake earlier this year remains a cited overhang.
No company-specific news found for today's -4.6% move; reads as beta/spillover from the broader AI-adjacent small-cap selloff rather than an idiosyncratic event.
RSI now 29.1, crossing into oversold territory; MACD turned positive July 22 even as the Aroon indicator turned down the same day - a mixed technical picture.
Next catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings August 6, 2026 (after close).

FDA's PCAC panel delivered a split, non-binding verdict over two days: July 23 backed adding BPC-157/KPV/TB-500 to the compounding list (stock spiked >10%), but July 24 voted against emideltide and Semax/Epitalon faced FDA staff opposition - HIMS gave back the entire rally plus more (-14.2%) on 'sell the news' positioning. Final FDA rulemaking is still pending; this is not a resolved catalyst.
Unconfirmed side note: reports of the CFO selling ~$229K in shares in the days just before the panel meeting - flagged, not clearly tied to today's move.
Q2 2026 earnings due August 10, 2026.

Q2 FY26 beat on both lines: revenue $3.99B (+24% YoY) vs. $3.92B consensus; non-GAAP EPS $0.90 vs. $0.86 consensus. Full-year subscription guide raised to $15.76-15.78B (~22.5% growth) from $15.53-15.57B.
Now Assist AI annual-contract-value commitment raised from $1B to $1.5B; AI-related ACV already exceeds $1B; cRPO $13.2B, RPO ~$29B (+~21%).
Next earnings ~October 28, 2026 (Q3 FY26) - estimated from prior-year cadence, not yet company-confirmed.
Reports earnings after the close July 29, 2026 (5 days); consensus ~$4.23 EPS. No other material news since last update.

No fresh company-specific news today; -4.2% move reads as continued bleed-off from the July 9 S&P downgrade (BBB-) tied to a raised FY2027 capex outlook (~$90-95B vs. prior ~$60B) and a projected ~$42B free-cash-flow deficit.
$0.50/share quarterly dividend paid today as scheduled (routine, not a decline driver).
Stock down ~28% over the trailing month; RSI now 28.2, a deepening oversold read alongside APLD/CoreWeave/Nebius in the same AI-capex-debt selloff.
+4.0% today reads as an oversold bounce (RSI had fallen near 30 after a ~12% five-day slide to a 52-week low) rather than a new positive catalyst.
Fundamentals still soft: 30-yr mortgage rates hit their highest level of 2026 this week; Zillow itself cut its 2026 home-sales growth forecast to as low as -0.73% (from +4.3%) if rates stay elevated.
Jefferies maintained Buy on July 14 but cut its price target from $75 to $60.
